content.value: A flat belt connects pulley A, which drives a machine tool, to pulley B, which is attached 17 to the shaft of an electric motor. The co-efficients of friction are $\mu _ { s } = 0 . 2 5 , \ \mu _ { k } = 0 . 2 .$ between both pulleys and the belt. Knowing that the maximum allowable tension in the belt is 600-lb. Determine the largest torque which can be exerted by the belt on pulley A.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
